important_decisions: JSDoc required on every schema field including nested schemas
data-* attributes drive all bounded-enum CSS variants
background prop in HeroBanner is the only case needing inline style (unbounded CSS color)
columns prop uses z.union([z.literal(2), z.literal(3)]) — not z.enum — for numeric literals (Zod v4)
Gallery puts data-columns/data-gap on __grid child, not root, because that is where the CSS custom props are consumed
